svg.text: Signal patch map — what every measured channel is wired to
All 43 channels the daemon streams. Cyan = patched and driving the image. Amber = a contention channel, drives the warning colour. Purple = measured and streaming, driving nothing yet.

Conditioning on every link is the same: value → log1p(v)/log1p(ref) with a decaying peak tracker on ref → exponential moving average (α 0.10). No FFT, STFT or autocorrelation anywhere in the chain yet.
FREE INPUTS — measured, streaming, driving nothing
25 channels patched · 18 free · 43 measured in total

KIND decides what is legal: level = filter/STFT/autocorrelate, never differentiate · rate = log1p first, already a derivative · event = convolve to an envelope before any spectral work · state = edges only
The purple block is your free surface: 18 channels already streaming at full rate, costing nothing extra, currently driving nothing.
